sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.8 27B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8 27B is the model from Alibaba's new Qwen 3.8 family that you can actually run locally: a dense 27B multimodal model that fits on a 24 GB GPU or a 32 GB Mac at 4-bit quantization. This guide covers our Atomic Dynamic GGUF builds, how much memory each one needs, and the exact setup for both Atomic Chat and llama.cpp.
